coastal.title: Langford tries new tool for mitigating wildfires: a herd of goats
coastal.description: A herd of 13 goats spent Friday clambering to munch on a thicket of blackberry bushes and brambles near the Starlight Stadium in Langford – part of a pilot program to prune the city's flammable underbrush and raise awareness of fire safety tools.

kamloops.title: Wildfires expose accessibility failures: advocates
kamloops.description: Janice Lyons was upstairs in her Summerland, B.C., home when there was a flash at her doorbell, which lights up in her Deaf household in place of a chime.

kamloops.title: Preschool fire safety lessons put to the test during Summerland evacuation
kamloops.description: As Learning Cove Preschool prepares to welcome children back, staff say fire safety lessons taught in the classroom helped prepare students

kamloops.title: Summerland family feels 'violated' after burglary during wildfire evacuation
kamloops.description: Mira Boucher says her home was ransacked by looters while her community of Summerland was empty and vulnerable — with every single house vacant under an evacuation order.

kamloops.title: Pear Lake wildfire sparks new evacuations, crews battle new fire near Kamloops
kamloops.description: Officials have expanded evacuation orders related to British Columbia's largest wildfire.

kamloops.title: Summerland wildfire evacuee says overhaul of emergency support services needed
kamloops.description: Dawne Young, a retired 911 dispatcher, said her evacuation experience was unsettling. Her neighbour's home was lost in the Bald Range wildfire. She said her family did not all receive the emergency alert, and she was met with lengthy delays trying to register as an evacuee.

kamloops.title: Crops sacrificed, losses mount for B.C.  farmers grappling with historic drought
kamloops.description: Severe drought in the southern Interior is causing some irrigation systems to virtually run dry.

kamloops.title: Following fire, Summerland orchards race to save fruit from spoilage
kamloops.description: While Deep Brar’s property is physically undamaged by the flames, his business, Brarstar Orchards, has still incurred a significant cost — much of his fruit was left to rot on the trees during the evacuation.
